verdict: GBP engagement softening across all three locations; overdue work being resolved.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, Google Business Profile was the only active channel this period — paid search and social carried zero spend. Combined, your three locations logged 382 total GBP actions over the last 28 days, but engagement has been declining week-over-week at each location, consistent with seasonal demand softening rather than a listing or visibility problem. A meaningful set of planned deliverables across CRM, SEO, outreach, and content have fallen behind schedule, and those workstreams are being escalated and resolved now. As that work lands — re-indexing, outreach sequences, and CRM automations — you should expect broader activity that is not dependent on organic search alone.
